limitations: The study reports mouse group, kidney number, and technical replicate but not animal ages or sexes; these are not annotated.
No per-sample disease term is supported by the supplement, so the permitted sentinel not available is used.
The treatment factor retains the repository-supported group labels; the template does not permit an equivalent controlled characteristics[treatment] value for vehicle.
